description: Dept. of Inland Revenue - Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017 - Notice under Section 1950
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the repeal and substitution of a schedule under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. It deals with regulatory matters, specifically the registration requirements and qualifications for authorized tax representatives. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework amendments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
